description: This module lets you pause/unpause Pingdom alerts.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Define whether or not the check should be running or paused. Choices: "running" "paused" "started" "stopped"

examples:
- name: Pause the check with the ID of 12345
  community.general.pingdom:
    uid: example@example.com
    passwd: password123
    key: apipassword123
    checkid: 12345
    state: paused

- name: Unpause the check with the ID of 12345
  community.general.pingdom:
    uid: example@example.com
    passwd: password123
    key: apipassword123
    checkid: 12345
    state: running
